Option B: x = 0.4 > g(x) = 0.001 (Eliminate this option)
Option D: x = 0.4 > g(x) = 0.25 (Eliminate this option)
We now have Option A and C left.
Let’s test another point. say when x = —0.5.
Soy = g(x) should include the point 0.175).
(As stated above, for y = g(f(x)), substitute the f(x) values into g(x))
Option C: x = —0.3 > g(x) + —0.001 (Eliminate this option)
Therefore, Option A must be correct.
